name: Standing Cable Crunch
cues: Stand with your back to a high pulley, the rope beside your head
Soften your knees and keep your hips still
Curl your ribs down toward your pelvis
Return slowly until your torso is upright

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Load direction is right: stack is highest at the crunch with back to the pulley. Spinal flexion is 54 deg (lumbar 26 + thorax 28) with zero hip flexion (-4..0), and the whole body leans forward from the ankles (dorsiflexion 18-22, knees 14-24) to counter the cable. The lean is physically justified but looks like a ski lean. The cue rewrite changes the described setup, so the owner should confirm.
